title: Bran and other residues from the working of cereals or legumes; vegetable materials and vegetable waste, vegetable residues and by-products, whether or not in the form of pellets, of a kind used in animal feeding n.e.c.

review.classification: UNSD pp. 199–200 explicitly cover bran from cereal milling, with separate subclasses for starch and brewing residues. The producer expressly documents loose milled wheat bran sold as animal feed. This supports one narrower qualified scope even though other states can also belong to the same classification.
review.state_and_route: Reviewed the retained public prospectus for the Modern Mills dry roller joint flour route and separate feed terminal. Engelke documents a loose feed sale. Cefetra distinguishes dry-milling meal and pellet forms and identifies its composition figures as noncontractual. Foreign material, receiver, state and measured moisture enter as actual study evidence.
review.quantity_and_allocation: Reviewed both editions for as-released net mass at first conformance, provision of the raw bran fraction and joint burden once, measured moisture, stock closure, historical FG service, returns, Q=0 and the single normalization. Wet-basis means the actual moisture in the as-released product. Allocation does not scale gross material, packaging or the reference.
review.native_and_bilingual: Independently matched the exact original Wheat bran / 麦麸 native file from the pinned historical archive. Verified the Mass and kg support chain from the same pinned archive. The native file supports the broad identity, while the feed designation, loose form and provider match remain substantiated separately. Twenty-nine auxiliary exchange identities are explicitly unresolved.
